cover.prompt: On the cliff road beside the rock-cut granary of Arche, arche-accountant in an ankle-length chiton stands in 3/4 view checking a cargo inventory, holding a slate tally board away from his body with both arms spread wide; arche-clerk gestures emphatically toward an open storage alcove, body arched forward 15 degrees in dynamic posture; in the midground a two-wheeled wooden cart laden with terracotta amphorae rolls along the carved stone road bed; a rusticated stone corner of the granary portal anchors the right frame margin; behind them the vertical sea cliff plunges into the dark blue Aegean, with razor-sharp shadow lines cast by the morning sun.
cover.others: a cart driver guiding the donkey.
